[http://www.foodista.com/recipe/SM7XMDG4/vegan-eggnog-milkshake Originally posted to Foodista] by user Teresa Lindsey. Foodista recipes are released under a [http://www.foodista.com/static/legal CC-BY license].

==Ingredients==
*2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] of Silk Nog (vegan eggnog substitute)
*1 [[Cookbook:Pint|pint]] of Soy Dream vanilla [[Cookbook:Ice Cream|ice cream]]
*[[Cookbook:Nutmeg|Nutmeg]]

==Preparation==
#Blend nog and ice cream together in [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]].
#Pour into a glass, and sprinkle with nutmeg.
